items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Well Zoo Robinson was supposed to be a good piano player.

ctx.x: One thing I'd like to ask you, while you mention his name was Zoo Robinson, was it Zoo Robinson? Yeah, Zoo Robinson. I guess he left here pretty, it must have been a pretty long time ago. Do you remember anything about the way he played or anything about it?
Well Zoo Robinson was supposed to be a good piano player.
